title: Sample 13-2: Poem with Stanza Numbers

illustrates.quote: Use cell-5 headings for stanza numbers.

blocks.features: Byline, plain text below the title.
First stanza of Tennyson's "A Victim", 8 main poetic lines each followed by an indented sub-line, then a further-indented block of 8 short quoted-speech lines.

lines.text: A plague upon the people fell,
A famine after laid them low;
Then thorpe and byre arose in fire,
For on them brake the sudden foe;
So thick they died the people cried,
‘The Gods are moved against the land.’
The Priest in horror about his altar
To Thor and Odin lifted a hand:
What would you have of us?
